landing.hero_subtitle: UDGAM connects Indian farmers, buyers, and transporters through explainable AI quality grading, precision demand matching, and coordinated zero-waste logistics.
landing.problem_title: Why Indian Agriculture Needed a Connected Intelligence Layer
landing.problem_sub: Traditional agricultural supply chains are fragmented across multi-tier middlemen, causing severe price erosion, unverified quality disputes, and empty truck return miles.
landing.problem_trad_1: 5 to 7 middlemen between farm & end buyer
landing.problem_trad_2: Only 28–32% of consumer spend reaches the farmer
landing.problem_trad_3: Subjective visual grading causes payment disputes
landing.problem_trad_4: 40%+ empty return trips for rural transporters
landing.problem_udgam_3: Computer Vision objective grading with explainability
landing.problem_udgam_4: 21% vehicle distance saved via load pooling
landing.roles_sub: UDGAM gives farmers, buyers, and transporters equal power, absolute transparency, and shared economic upside.
landing.role_farmer_title: Sell Produce Directly at Real Market Value
landing.role_farmer_desc: Eliminate dependency on mandi commission agents. List your harvest in seconds, receive instant AI computer vision quality assessment, and get matched with genuine bulk buyers.
landing.role_farmer_f1: Instant crop listing with photo-based grading
landing.role_farmer_f2: Direct discovery of matching verified buyers
landing.role_farmer_f4: FPO member batching for bulk negotiation
landing.role_buyer_title: Source Verified Quality Produce with Reliable Logistics
landing.role_buyer_desc: Discover verified lots directly from farm gates or FPOs. Post custom procurement requirements, review transparent CV quality metrics, and track live transport from farm to warehouse.
landing.role_buyer_f1: Direct farm-origin procurement at transparent pricing
landing.role_buyer_f2: Computer Vision blemish and shape verification
landing.role_buyer_f3: Automated matching engine for open requirements
landing.role_buyer_f4: Coordinated transport assignment with milestone tracking
landing.role_transporter_title: Maximize Truck Capacity with Consolidated Agri Routes
landing.role_transporter_desc: Eliminate empty return runs. Pick up aggregated farm loads along optimal corridors, receive guaranteed freight payments through platform escrow, and boost vehicle utilization.
landing.role_transporter_f1: Discover farm pickup jobs along your preferred corridors
landing.role_transporter_f2: Multi-stop pickup consolidation to maximize tonnage
landing.role_transporter_f3: Optimized waypoint routing and distance calculations
landing.role_transporter_f4: Direct freight payout upon verified delivery OTP
landing.ai_sub: Not black-box hype. UDGAM implements practical, explainable intelligence that directly protects stakeholder income and logistics efficiency.
landing.ai_card1_desc: Analyzes surface color richness, skin blemishes, and shape uniformity from smartphone photos to determine Grade A, B, or C with full explainability.
landing.ai_card2_desc: Ranks buyers and produce lots by matching price tolerance, quality threshold, quantity scale, and geographic haul distance into a single unified score.
landing.ai_card3_desc: Groups nearby farm pickups into shared vehicle trips, optimizing waypoints to cut fuel costs and reduce transit time for perishable produce.
landing.ai_card4_desc: Combines mandi benchmark data and live marketplace bidding to provide fair pricing guidance that prevents distress selling.
landing.transparency_title: Zero Hidden Cuts. Complete Financial Clarity.
landing.transparency_sub: Every rupee is accounted for. Buyers see exactly what they pay, transporters see their exact freight, and farmers keep what they earn.
landing.trans_sim_note: Payment is held securely in escrow and released to farmer and transporter upon delivery verification.
landing.trust_f1_desc: Full support for English, Hindi, and Marathi with vernacular typography designed for Devanagari text flow.
landing.trust_f2_desc: Offline-ready caching ensures critical order and listing details are visible even in remote rural connectivity zones.
landing.trust_f3_desc: Generous touch targets and high-contrast styling designed for outdoor sunlight visibility and calloused hands.
landing.trust_f4_desc: Enterprise-grade PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) guarantees complete data isolation and privacy across all roles.
landing.cta_banner_title: Ready to Experience the Future of Agricultural Commerce?
landing.cta_banner_sub: Join thousands of farmers, bulk buyers, and transport operators building a fair, intelligent food supply chain across India.
landing.footer_brand_desc: Direct farmer-to-buyer agricultural marketplace with AI quality grading and coordinated logistics.
landing.footer_sih: Built for Smart India Hackathon 2026 (Problem Statement SIH26033).
